environment.description: Quarkus 2.16 native image deployed on AWS Lambda via custom runtime. PostgreSQL 14 RDS instance with RLS policies on tenant_records table (policy: USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))). Lambda execution role has AmazonRDSDataFullAccess. No deserialization filtering configured. Container image based on quay.io/quarkus/ubi-quarkus-mandrel-builder-image:22.3 with commons-collections4 4.4 on classpath for legacy compatibility. Lambda has outbound internet access via NAT gateway. No JEP-290 filter configured in native-image build.
